ألتقي (form VIII)
# أَلْتَقِي (ʔaltaqī) /ʔal.ta.qiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# أَلْتَقِيَ (ʔaltaqiya) /ʔal.ta.qi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
